Grayscale Launches Dogecoin Trust

Grayscale has launched a Dogecoin Trust with a 2.5% management fee, giving qualified institutional and individual investors exposure to DOGE. With a market cap exceeding $33.5B, DOGE is evolving from a memecoin to a global financial tool. https://t.co/FCK3xSlD59

Bloomberg’s ETF Analysis team just dropped their predictions on the likelihood of the SEC approving spot crypto ETFs in 2025:

🪙 Litecoin (LTC) – 90%
🪙 Dogecoin (DOGE) – 75%
🪙 Solana (SOL) – 70%
🪙 XRP – 65% https://t.co/1lRSlQM3fX

Mainstream Memecoins Signal Changing Markets

A memecoin named PNUT surged from $0.1 to $2.27 in just days after viral outrage over a pet squirrel's euthanization, pushing its market cap over $2bn. It's the fastest-growing memecoin on record, outpacing even Dogecoin.
